titre_page: How to create your own nodes (My nodes)? | Yop2D guide
description: Group several nodes into a single node of your own, with settings (number, text, object), reusable anywhere in your game with Yop2D, no code.
h1: How to create your own nodes?
carte: Put a series of nodes into a single node of your own, with its settings, and reuse it everywhere.
blocs: p

When you build the same series of nodes several times (for example: an enemy that blinks, plays a sound and loses life), you can **put it into a single node of your own**. You write it once, then you **run** it anywhere, with **settings** that change from place to place (the speed, the message, the target object…).
besoin
a project open in the editor;
a small series of nodes you would like to reuse.
h2
Step 1: create your node
bloc
ol
In the editor, open the **Resources** panel and find **My nodes**.
Touch **+** and give it a name, for example **Take_hit**.
Select it and touch the **Blueprint** icon: you land on an empty Blueprint reserved for this node.
Build your series of nodes as usual, then save (💾). The Blueprint title says **My node: Take_hit**.
h2
Step 2: give it settings
bloc
ol
In your node's Blueprint, touch the **My node settings** button (at the top).
Touch **+ Add an input**: give it a name (for example **speed**), choose its **type** and its **starting value**.
In the nodes of your node, write the input's name in a formula: **=speed**.
A **Number** input is a number; **Text**, a message; **Yes / no**, a switch; **Object**, the name of an object in the scene.
tip

**The Object type**: whoever runs your node chooses which object it acts on. In the nodes of your node, open **On what?**: a **My node settings** group offers "Input … of my node". The same node can then make an enemy, a chest or the hero blink.
h2
Step 3: place it in a Blueprint
bloc
ol
Open the Blueprint of a scene.
In the nodes panel, the **My nodes** category is at the top of the list: touch your node.
A **Run one of my nodes** node arrives already set to yours, with one line per setting: fill them in (a number, a formula, an object name…).
h2
Step 4: share a node
bloc
ol
Open your node's Blueprint and touch the selection button **⬚**, then select all the nodes (draw a frame in the empty space).
Touch **⧉ Copy**, and paste the result in a message for your friend.
Your friend creates an empty node, opens its Blueprint, touches **"{ }"** and pastes: the series appears.
tip
Sharing carries the **nodes**, not the images or sounds they use: send those separately. The **settings** (inputs) are recreated with the **My node settings** button.
h2
If it does not work
bloc
ul
**My node is not in the menu:** it must be saved; close and reopen the Blueprint to refresh the list.
**My setting line is missing:** open the "Run one of my nodes" window: the lines update when you change node.
**Nothing happens:** your node must start with a node linked to the rest, and the call node must be linked to an event.
